Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The button is never re-enabled when an export fails because the promise rejection is unhandled and busy remains true.
